events.verdict: Wade (MIA) makes incidental contact with Simmons (ORL) that does not affect his SQBR.
Simmons (ORL) ends his dribble and does not take more than two steps after his gather. Additionally, Simmons releases his pass before he returns to the floor.
There is no clear and conclusive camera angle that shows if Richardson (MIA) has both hands on the ball when he brings his dribble to a pause.

RATR shows that Gordon (ORL) makes incidental "high-five" contact with McGruder (MIA) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt. McGruder grabs Gordon's right arm to create the additional contact.
RLS shows that McGruder (MIA) makes marginal contact with Fournier (ORL) that does not affect his ability to pass.
Wade (MIA) makes incidental contact with Gordon (ORL) that does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Wade (MIA) does not make contact to Simmons' (ORL) head during rebounding.
Adebayo (MIA) and Vucevic (ORL) make incidental contact with one another attempting to retrieve the loose ball.
Vucevic (ORL) is firming up in a legal screening position in McGruder's (MIA) path and does not deliver contact.
Fournier (ORL) and Richardson (MIA) briefly engage and separate off ball without affecting the other player's SQBR.
Fournier (ORL) establishes a legal guarding position in Richardson's (MIA) path and makes incidental contact that does not affect his ability to pass.
Gordon (ORL) legally contests Dragic's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Wade (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it from Fournier (ORL).
McGruder (MIA) makes incidental contact with Fournier (ORL) after the ball is cleanly dislodged by Wade (MIA).
RAR shows that Dragic (MIA) wraps Grant (ORL) and affects his SQBR during the inbound.
Adebayo (MIA) cleanly deflects the ball away from Vucevic (ORL).
RIchardson (MIA) cleanly ties up Vucevic (ORL), and a held ball is correctly called.
RAR shows that Grant (ORL) clamps Dragic's (MIA) arm and affects his ability to get to the loose ball.
Grant (ORL) legally contests Dragic's (MIA) shot attempt at the rim.
Dragic (MIA) makes marginal contact with Simmons (ORL) as he releases the pass.
Grant (ORL) does not intentionally kick the ball on the play.
Richardson (MIA) commits a take foul on Simmons (ORL). The take foul occurs prior to the head contact from Simmons to Richardson and is considered incidental.
Isaac (ORL) dislodges Olynyk (MIA) from his legally obtained position on the perimeter.
Wade (MIA) commits a take foul on Fournier (ORL).
RAR shows that Isaac (ORL) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Richardson's (MIA) drive to the basket.
RAR shows that Richardson (MIA) steps OOB on the baseline during his drive to the basket.
Johnson (MIA) briefly engages with Fournier (ORL) but does not affect his SQBR during the inbound.
Johnson (MIA) commits a take foul on Fournier (ORL).
